independent_review.body:
Read-only acceptance review of #67 at da74a4327579ac090846e142f7a1fb834451a7bb.

Verdict: ACCEPTED within the contribution's explicitly limited scope. I found no substantive bug or overclaim in the S-only satisfiable-shape projection, the independent semantic boundary, or the separation between certificate replay and automatic decision. This is not acceptance of the native Lean/full-repository theorem or of automatic depth-two success.

Reviewed paths and lines:
- notes/2026-09-20-issue67-independent-fixtures.md: 42-67 (independent forward/reverse predicates and complete acyclic DAG scope), 134-186 (projection steps 2-5), 188-220 (counts, UNKNOWN boundaries, and profile interpretation), 266-280 (remaining obligations).
- experiments/issue67_independent_fixtures.py: 65-187 (independent bounded witness/safety/first-return predicates), 190-253 (independent table observer and query predicates), 256-297 (finite S-only enumeration), 360-428 (literal oracle plus two certificate-directed compiler promotions), 430-496 (complete projected union and reconstructed witnesses), 517-564 (raw union/automatic UNKNOWN handling), and 606-689 (strict/stress orchestration and receipt fields).
- The pinned production rank_preimage.py definitions: compile_diagram, path_shapes, iter_diagrams, finish_queries, and decide (source-pinned by the harness); the relevant path-shape and portal cases agree with the note's classification.
- The released cases.json and receipt.json were also checked for the stated 13-case scope and status fields.

Projection readback: for root/end queries with no equalities or disequalities, safe nonempty bases, true table predicates, and S-only transitions, root cannot be fresh, end cannot be core, end must be LAST, and F/K portals are unavailable to S-only observers. Thus only core/enter-S/forward survives. The enumerator covers both weak FIRST/LAST orders and all finite controls, states, bits, and masks, then invokes unchanged compile_diagram. Invalid classes are rejected or unsatisfiable; they are not silently omitted as possible S-only witnesses. This proves the stated U versus U_S equivalence for that restricted scope, while correctly leaving physical exhaustion of the original iterator open.

Semantic boundary: the expected answers come from the independent literal predicate over all acyclic paths/reverse continuations up to the all-state DAG bound, including diagonal and empty suffix cases. Production graph/model checks are separate cross-checks. The suite does not establish cyclic inputs, arbitrary word bounds, Lean execution, or the finite-expression C081 frontend.

Evidence boundary: the forced two-promotion case is correctly labeled certificate-directed. The code performs actual compile_diagram/model/reconstruct_reference calls at both stages, replays the same intermediate reference, checks the final independent witness, and records max compiled depth 2 (harness lines 407-427). It does not claim automatic whole-terminal success. The two automatic depth-two cases and four raw unpruned unions remain UNKNOWN. The parent replay reports strict 13/13 under both seeds and all six capped diagnostics UNKNOWN; these do not promote the open automatic/native claims.

The only wording refinement I recommend is in the note at lines 210-214: replace “no observed depth-two winning query” with “the cap was reached after 5,784 depth-one clauses without observing a depth-two success; status remains UNKNOWN.” That makes it impossible to read the profile as an exhaustive negative. The existing status fields already preserve UNKNOWN, so this is clarity only. Also retain the documented cross-host difference in finish_queries profile-resumption counters; it does not change semantic/count/provenance results.

Durable reproducer commands recorded by the contribution (not rerun by this read-only review):
```
python3 experiments/issue67_independent_fixtures.py --output /tmp/issue67/strict.json
python3 experiments/issue67_independent_fixtures.py --seed 77 --output /tmp/issue67/replay.json
python3 experiments/issue67_independent_fixtures.py --mode stress --max-work 100000 --wall-seconds 20 --cpu-seconds 18 --output /tmp/issue67/stress.json
```
The recorded projection counts are exact3/odd: 5280 candidates, 400 rejected, 4880 compiled, 1 satisfied; exact4/odd: 7040, 560, 6480, 0. These are counts for the finite projected union, not the original unpruned iterator.

Remaining obligations are exactly those stated in the note: independent review of the ordinary projection proof, automatic native depth-two discovery, original-union completion or a new completeness result, Lean/full-repository replay, and C081 frontend execution.
